instruction: All three characters buy BET on LCN before the mission. After the mission, sell. Rival stocks drop; this step only counts the Betta gain.
Buy DEB while it is depressed after the hotel hit. Sell after the multi-target mission.
Buy FRT on BAWSAQ before the mission. Save, wait for the rebound if it dips, then sell. The multiplier here is the conservative published gain.
Buy VAP before the mission and sell after the spike.
Buy GCD before the last assassination and sell after. Do this one last so the earlier multipliers compound.
